meaning:
1) to kick, kick at
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to kick
1a2) to kick at
1a3) to desire (fig.)

elsewhere.note: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock…
Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded in my habitation, and honor your sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the best…
